You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Can model CS-400 stay with internal production control after 20 January 2027?

[1] digital instructions, manufacturer — retentionPeriod — make them accessible online during the expected lifetime (for at least 10 years) [condition: after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product] [REG, Art. 10(7)]

[4] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]

[12] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]

[18] machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — internal production control (Module A) (internal production control (module a)) [condition: Where applicable] [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 9]

[20] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]

[25] manufacturer — hasObligation — the internal measures that will be implemented (the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the partly completed machinery remains in conformity) [condition: for partly completed machinery produced in series] [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[26] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — internal production control (module A) (internal production control (module a)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[27] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]

[30] internal measures for series production — hasObligation — the internal measures that will be implemented (the internal measures that will be implemented) [condition: for machinery or related products produced in series] [REG, Annex IV, Part A]

[33] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical file kept by notified body — retentionPeriod — for a period of five years (P5Y) [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[34] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall keep the technical documentation (shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of incorporation at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities) [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[35] Article 6(7) and Articles 48 and 52 — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 13]
[36] original declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[37] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[38] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: followed by EU type-examination (module B), under option (a)] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[39] manufacturer — hasObligation — the internal measures that will be implemented (the internal measures that will be implemented) [condition: for series manufacture] [DIR, Annex VII]
[40] machinery CE marking date — hasObligation — It is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery (it is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery) [condition: when affixing the CE marking] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]
[41] Directive 2006/42/EC — repealedFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
[42] 1.2.4.4 assembly of machinery or related products — requiresMeasure — stop controls, including the emergency stop devices (stop controls, including the emergency stop devices) [condition: if its continued operation may be dangerous] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.4.4]

[44] machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions — listedIn — 6. (annex I, part A, point 6) [condition: in respect only of those systems] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]

[48] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately (devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately) [condition: if the driver loses control, if it receives a stop signal, if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, if no validation signal is detected within a specified time] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[49] control devices — requiresMeasure — protected against any accidental release (protected against any accidental release) [REG, Annex III, 5.3]

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The facts do not say whether CS-400 belongs to a category listed in Annex I, Part B, or to a category not listed in Annex I, so they cannot decide whether internal production control (Module A) is available to it. Article 25(3) requires Module A for listed Part B categories, and Article 25(4) requires it for categories not listed in Annex I. Corrigendum point 6 separately allows products placed on the market under Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027 to be placed until 20 January 2027.", "used": [26, 28, 18, 16]}
